verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a public TypeScript plugin API (obsidian-api, including the Vault interface for files and folders) and an Obsidian URI protocol that can trigger actions such as opening or creating notes, and one community user confirms using the API for automation. However, the plugin API runs as in-app extension code, and the URI scheme covers only a limited set of actions, so there is no evidence of an external, remote-callable API an agent could drive directly. Missing for 10: a documented external/remote (e.g. REST) API for programmatic control, breadth of URI actions beyond open/create, agent-oriented usage documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
